signature_moves: Dual 'report card' language: UX audit as colour-coded left-ruled finding cards with Critical/Major/Minor chips, mirrored by the assistant's structured 'Page N Highlights' text summary — coherent and purposeful, but a web signature (component callouts + chat), not transferable mac taste
AI-orb brand through-line: the icon's luminous blue→lavender ring echoed in the wordmark's glowing 'o'
Overall verdict: competent-but-web — polished dark AI-assistant wrapper in the 2025 'dark neutral + electric blue' idiom
defects: Focal Collision — two filled toolbar pills adjacent (white 'How it works' + blue 'Open Document'); canon = one filled primary per region
Contrast Dilution (mild) — severity chip text pink-on-pink/yellow-on-yellow (<4.5:1); 'Aligns with/Violates' metadata not de-emphasized from body
Pure-black dark surfaces — sidebar #000000 plus three unrelated dark values across panes; HIG dark-mode correction = avoid pure black, one elevated tonal ramp
Non-native selection — bordered navy fill vs the flat inset accent fill (visible border is the tell)
Faint card borders — ~1px near-white hairlines on the white document card likely <3:1

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark neutral ramp + one electric-blue accent + glow), delivered in an Electron/webview wrapper — the current default-model 'dark SaaS' reach-for look
aesthetic.cluster_hint: electron-ai-dark (non-native web cluster; excluded from macOS canon)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single blue 'Open Document' should be the one different thing, but the adjacent white filled pill dilutes it (violation → focal collision)
Aesthetic-usability effect (Kurosu & Kashimura) — the luminous dark polish buys first-impression trust; used well as a halo
Miller/Cowan chunking + progressive disclosure — findings chunked into Strengths/Issues/Recommendations with severity tiers reduces working-memory load (good use)
Jakob's Law — apes iMessage bubbles and web-SaaS chrome so users feel at home in WEB conventions, at the cost of Mac-native expectations (in-app dark toggle, wordmark toolbar, filled pills)
Recognition over recall — assistant composer uses placeholder-as-label ('Ask about this document…'); acceptable in a chat box, minor
notes: Only one asset: a 1200x630 marketing composite (blue gradient backdrop, 'Search with Zero Resistance' headline, 'Download Sero' pill, floating AI-orb icon). The app window is rendered BELOW 1:1 inside it — no clean @2x, so all geometry is (estimated) with wide ranges and low precision; colour samples are clean sRGB and more trustworthy. No discrete screenshots and no light-mode surface were supplied. icon.png (1024²) exists — a black squircle with a glowing blue→lavender orb ring — but was NOT digested (task scope is Workflow A / UI only); note it for a future Workflow B icon pass. LINEAGE GATE: web-electron (high) — profile it, but exclude every property from macOS canon and native clusters; record only as tells + corrections. Accent #0A84FF is system-blue-adjacent, which slightly softens the 'wrong accent' finding, but it is still applied as a brand colour rather than bound to the system accent.
